metadata.description: Track A re-run with calibrated NWP — strike accuracy and probability calibration baseline for Track B

summary.directional_note: Bias correction is shift-invariant — directional accuracy is identical for raw and calibrated NWP. The 53.5% GEFS figure from Phase 0 stands as the directional baseline. Calibration improves STRIKE accuracy and probability sharpness, not direction.

ecmwf.interpretation: Directional accuracy: 71.3% (n=1818). Bias correction is shift-invariant — direction doesn't change. The real value of calibration is in strike-level probability calibration, which requires the full signal pipeline to measure.

ecmwf.interpretation: 14.7% of actual temps fell within the calibrated 50% CI. Overconfident. GEFS spread_ratio=0.155 → calibrated σ = raw_std/0.155 = 6.45× → distribution is VERY wide, so 14.7% should be near 50%.

summary.track_b_expected: Track B (per-model pools) is expected to improve strike-level accuracy by 3-8pp by using model-specific calibrated spreads. Directional accuracy may not improve since it's dominated by day-over-day temp persistence, not absolute calibration.
